The first draft is initiated by eng. Emad El 
din Ali Elbana, reviewed by eng. Sadek Massoad, revised by EDEPC inspection & 
quality control eng. Samir Abd El- Gelil, approved by general manager eng. Mokhter Abd Ellatif,

 staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Isolate the circuit breaker for motor of 
 this pump

Isolate the electrical cable bearing of 
 the motor of this pump

The pump must be is isolated mechanically 
 by closing suction and delivery valves
 and drain it.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, suitable lifting device
Manual puller, feeler gauges.
Lessen set screws, grease.

Remove tubing (27) from inboard end (3) 
 and outboard end (2) of pump.

Remove packing
 (21) from packing cover 
 box (4).

Remove bolts (7) from each cover (2) & 
 (3) for remove outboard end ,inboard cover (2) & (3), and gasket (6).

Remove bolts (30), cover (8) and gasket 
 (5) from outboard cover (2)

Remove cap screws (18) internal tooth 
 washers (19) and shim (16) from outboard bracket (11).

Remove bracket (11) from housing (10) by 
 remove bolts (14) for each side.

Remove spring pin (15) to slide bushing 
 (26) from (12) for each side.

rotor each inboard and outboard 
 Idler (four Idlers) from housing (24),(23) slide power rotor form housing (22)

Remove capscrews (12) and internal tooth 
 washers (13) to remove cover (17).

Check the Main rotor (22) and renewed if 
 necessary.

Check inboard Idler (23) and renewed 
 if necessary.

Check outboard Idler (24) and renewed 
 if necessary.

Check Bushing (26) and renewed if 
 necessary.

Check shin (16) and renewed if 
 necessary.

Check sprint pin (15) and renewed if 
 necessary.

Check housing of pump (10) and 
 renewed if necessary.
Clean every part well.

Assembly every part in reverse sequence 
 of disassembly.

After finishing assembly of the pump 
 rotate the main shaft by hand.

Operate the pump by coordination 
 with the shift engineer.

Ensure that the pump is OK and record the 
 readings of pressure, temp., vibration, according to the technical 
 specification table at introduction, and compare with the previous reading.
